limitations.note: The rewrite fixes the shift direction but compares the window containing the new input, asserting match one clock earlier than the original registered checks, and adds a sample-count gate that suppresses matches involving reset-filled bits.

The testbench updates its history before computing the expected output and imposes the same nine-sample gate as the rewrite, so exhaustive pattern coverage could not catch either change from the original behavior.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the first test invocation to be rejected before simulation, requiring the test to be relaunched with a different temporary-directory mechanism.
